title: Tensor representatives and eventual zero for an arbitrary colimit on a cofinal tail
statement: Let I be a directed preorder, F:I→CommRing a diagram, and (C,ι) any colimit cocone [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Fix i₀≤k and an F(i₀)-module M₀. Give C and F(j) for j≥k their F(i₀)-algebra structures via ι_i₀ and F(i₀→j). Every element of C⊗_{F(i₀)}M₀ comes from F(j)⊗_{F(i₀)}M₀ at some j≥k. If an element of a stage j≥k maps to zero, its image is zero at a later l≥j. All tensor maps are induced by the diagram maps and identity on M₀; no finiteness or flatness is assumed. The module universe may differ from the ring and index universe.

source.place: Tags 00D6, 00D7 and 00DD; tensor-colimit argument used in Tag 02JO (3)

proof.text: Restrict to the nonempty directed upper tail J={j:k≤j}. Give A_j=F(j) its F(i₀)-algebra structure using i₀≤k≤j. Functoriality gives linear transition maps f and the cocone gives linear maps α to C, with the directed-system and compatibility identities.

Use Module.DirectLimit.lift to define g from the module direct limit to C. Concrete.isColimit_exists_rep gives a representative of any c∈C; moving above k proves surjectivity. Concrete.isColimit_exists_of_rep_eq gives a common stage for equal representatives; Module.DirectLimit.of_f proves injectivity. Thus LinearEquiv.ofBijective g identifies this module direct limit with C.

Compose the inverse of TensorProduct.directLimitLeft with the tensor of that linear equivalence. On each stage tensor, tensor induction and the pure-tensor formula for directLimitLeft show that the resulting equivalence is α.rTensor M₀.

Represent the inverse image of a limit tensor by Module.DirectLimit.exists_of. If a stage tensor maps to zero, injectivity of the constructed equivalence makes its direct-limit class zero; Module.DirectLimit.of.zero_exact gives a later stage where it vanishes. All subtype inequalities are transported back to I.

theorem tensorTailColimitElementwise
    {I : Type v} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (F : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{v}) (c : Cocone F) (hc : IsColimit c)
    (i₀ : I) (M₀ : Type w) [AddCommGroup M₀] [Module (F.obj i₀) M₀] (k : I) (hik : i₀ ≤ k) :
    let S := F.obj i₀
    let R := c.pt
    letI : Algebra S R := (c.ι.app i₀).hom.toAlgebra
    (∀ x : R ⊗[S] M₀, ∃ (i : I) (h : k ≤ i),
      letI : Algebra S (F.obj i) := (F.map (homOfLE (hik.trans h))).hom.toAlgebra
      let αᵢ : F.obj i →ₐ[S] R :=
        { (c.ι.app i).hom with
          commutes' := fun s ↦
            congrArg (fun f : F.obj i₀ ⟶ c.pt ↦ f s) (c.w (homOfLE (hik.trans h))) }
      ∃ t : F.obj i ⊗[S] M₀, αᵢ.toLinearMap.rTensor M₀ t = x) ∧
    (∀ (i : I) (h : k ≤ i),
      letI : Algebra S (F.obj i) := (F.map (homOfLE (hik.trans h))).hom.toAlgebra
      let αᵢ : F.obj i →ₐ[S] R :=
        { (c.ι.app i).hom with
          commutes' := fun s ↦
            congrArg (fun f : F.obj i₀ ⟶ c.pt ↦ f s) (c.w (homOfLE (hik.trans h))) }
      ∀ t : F.obj i ⊗[S] M₀, αᵢ.toLinearMap.rTensor M₀ t = 0 →
        ∃ (i' : I) (h' : i ≤ i'),
          letI : Algebra S (F.obj i') := (F.map (homOfLE (hik.trans (h.trans h')))).hom.toAlgebra
          let αᵢ'ᵢ : F.obj i →ₐ[S] F.obj i' :=
            { (F.map (homOfLE h')).hom with
              commutes' := fun s ↦
                congrArg (fun f : F.obj i₀ ⟶ F.obj i' ↦ f s)
                  (F.map_comp (homOfLE (hik.trans h)) (homOfLE h')).symm }
          αᵢ'ᵢ.toLinearMap.rTensor M₀ t = 0)
